profile.reading:
GW Ranch is a private-grid power generation campus that Pacifico Energy is developing on more than 8,000 acres in Pecos County, Texas, about 17 miles north of Fort Stockton, to serve hyperscale data centers. It is not connected to the ERCOT grid. In January 2026 the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality issued an air permit for up to 7.65 GW of gas-fired generation, which Pacifico describes as the largest such permit in the country.

Pacifico says the campus will combine gas turbines with battery storage and solar, with first power in the first quarter of 2027, 1 GW in 2028, and more than 5 GW by 2031. Gas arrives by a dedicated pipeline to the Waha Hub.

In August 2026 news reports linked three Amazon data center construction permits to the site; Amazon has not confirmed this here. The 7.65 GW is permitted generation, not data center IT capacity.

sources.title: Pacifico Energy Announces GW Ranch Project
Amazon behind massive private gas plant for new data centers

profile.capacity_note: 7.65 GW is the permitted gas generation; over 5 GW is Pacifico's stated delivery target. Neither is data center IT capacity.
